title: Possible race condition with animated sprites
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduced in:
Godot 4.3 - stable, with mostly crashes, if not, flood of errors ,and almost never not happening 
Godot 4.2.2 - stable , with doesn't crash as often, and it doesn't happen more often than on 4.3, but istill happens 
Godot 4.1.4 - stable, same as 4.3

also tested on Windows 10 machine, same results


### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.22631 - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 31.0.101.4953) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1335U (12 Threads)

### Issue description

Possible race condition when using tool script and setting animation on a sprite2d, when opening the editor in a scene with a child scene with these conditions either it crashes or it opens but the console is flooded if a error that has the message "!has_animation(p_name)" is true

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a Area2d scene
2. Add a node2d child
3. Add a AnimationPlayer2d child
4. Add spritesheet to the sprite
5. Add a couple of animation involving frames
6. Add a collisionshape2d child and give it a shape
7. Add a script with the following:

```gdscript
@tool
extends Area2D

enum animations {animation1, animation2}
@export var animation : animations = animations.animation1 : set = _set_animation

func _set_animation(new_aniamtion):
	animation = new_aniamtion
	if animation == animations.animation1:
		$AnimationPlayer.play("animacao 1")
	elif animation == animations.animation2:
		$AnimationPlayer.play("animacao 2")
```

8. Save the scene
9. Add another scene
10. Add the first scene as a child
11. Pick a animation in the inspector
12. Save it
13. Open the 2d visualization
14. Leave the editor with that tab open
15. Attempt to open again
